I saved that MDN link and the card looks right to me. At a glance I can see the little site icon, that it's from developer.mozilla.org, the title "CSS grid layout," a short description, and the address underneath — plus the preview panel on the left. That's exactly the kind of thing I want to see without having to open the link. And I like that I only had to paste the address and it filled the rest in.

The bar sitting above the collection feels natural too — that's where I'd expect to save from.

Two small things I want to make sure of, since they're part of this same saving flow: if the title or description that gets pulled in isn't quite right, I'll want to be able to fix it. And I'd assume the preview image is normally the actual picture from the page — here it's a colored panel with letters, which is fine as a stand-in for now, but I want the real thing when it's available. As far as the layout and the information shown, though, yes — this is the right approach.
